title: AdmTree: Compressing Lengthy Context with Adaptive Semantic Trees
selection_reason: Abstract states quadratic self-attention cost limits long-context LLMs and proposes adaptive hierarchical compression using semantic trees and gist tokens with a frozen backbone/lightweight aggregation. This directly reduces inference context cost while preserving semantic content.
